sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United, currently top with 22 points from 10 games, have two fixtures this week. They host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October (15:00), seeking to bounce back after a recent loss despite an otherwise strong recent record of one loss in their last five. They then travel away to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October (15:00) in what will be a key test against a struggling side near the foot of the table.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tough away trip to Dawley Town on 3 October, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall on the same day in a mid-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the standings, visit Wednesfield Community on 3 October in a local derby. The weekend's other 3 October fixtures include Brereton Social v Widnes Town, Cheadle Heath Nomads v Telford Town, Crewe v Allscott Heath, Foley Meir v Bilston Town (the latter among the division's in-form sides), Market Drayton Town v New Mills, and Shawbury United v Barnton. Midweek on 7 October sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community in a Wednesday evening fixture. The following Saturday (10 October) features a full schedule: Allscott Heath v Brereton Social, Alsager Town v Shawbury United, Barnton v Dawley Town, Bilston Town v Crewe, Market Drayton Town v Widnes Town, Stafford Town v Wednesfield Community, Telford Town v New Mills, and the aforementioned Sandbach v Cheadle Heath Nomads—a busy week of fixtures across the division.
